name: CSUMB SCC_Block05 inspected native bathymetry and terrain-habitat grids

producer.name: CSU Monterey Bay Seafloor Mapping Lab (CSUMB/SFML)

units.rough_smooth_terrain_class: coded 2 m cells; -1/-31 rough and 0/-30 smooth

rights.license: US federal archive distribution; original CSUMB product redistribution terms still under review

spatial.horizontal_crs: EPSG:26910 for inspected ArcInfo grids; WGS84 bounds are the separate NCEI track envelope

temporal.update_cadence: Static 2010 survey; monthly catalog check for revised releases, no automatic native-data replacement.

provenance.access_service: NOAA NCEI archive of CSUMB observations, not an independent survey
transformations: Opened exact bathymetry and habitat ArcInfo grids from the hash-pinned original archive; no datum conversion, interpolation or fishing target generation

evidence.supports: Primary archive identifies original producer, Reson 7125 and SEA SWATHplus sonar, 2010-04-15 through 2010-08-18 survey dates, and download links. Metadata HTTP GET returned 200.

CSUMB general metadata describes native 2 m products for 0–85 m depth and 5 m products for 80–250 m. It directs users to individual-file XML for detailed metadata; 2 m is documented product resolution, not an inspected raster result.
NCEI identifies bounds as the minimum rectangle of survey tracklines and reports vertical datum unknown. This is not a validated wet-cell footprint or full region coverage.

Full 214,391,255-byte original archive downloaded and SHA-256 verified on 2026-09-24. The included 2 m bathymetry ArcInfo grid opened with 6,731,576 valid EPSG:26910 cells and elevations -85 to -0.86 m; the aligned 2 m terrain-habitat grid opened with 6,705,573 valid cells. The hash-bound native audit is dist/data/csumb-scc-native-source-review.json.
USGS identifies CSUMB scc05_2mbathy as a 2 m ArcInfo GRID source used in the San Simeon geological interpretation. This source reference does not establish redistribution rights for the native grid.

limitations: Research candidate only. It does not authorize publication or establish any fish target, habitat classification, catch rate, boulder size or current fish location.

Block05 alone covers only a narrow strip within fishing_bounds [-121.32,35.53,-121.06,35.68]. Neighboring Block04 and Block06 also overlap the region but require separate product, coverage and rights review; neither their rectangles nor the Block05 rectangle prove continuous coverage.

The inspected 2 m elevation grid is NAVD88 Geoid09, not MLLW. The metadata states ±2 m horizontal and ±20 cm vertical accuracy varying with depth; it supplies no per-cell uncertainty band. A reviewed location-specific datum conversion and uncertainty budget are required before any under-200-ft fishing polygon can be certified.

The aligned habitat grid is a rough/smooth terrain classification derived from the same bathymetry, not independent sampled bedrock. -1 and -31 mean rough in two depth bands; 0 and -30 mean smooth. No rock-pile claim follows from a rough code alone.

The archive metadata gives liability and citation statements but no product-specific redistribution license was established in this review. Native and derived outputs remain withheld from public map/export.
NCEI soundings, CSUMB native grids and USGS SIM 3327 derivatives share underlying observations; do not count them as independent substrate evidence.
Bathymetry is a depth measurement, not a rock/sand classification. Geological interpretation, actual substrate groundtruth and complete closure geometry are separate checks.
Survey interval is April 15–August 18, 2010. Exact acquisition instants at any target are unknown.
